title: Deploy MSK Cluster and AWS SAM project with AWS Lambda to demonstrate SASL authentication
description: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses an Amazon MSK Topic as an event source.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: - An AWS CloudFormation template to deploy a serverless or provisioned MSK cluster (Apache Kafka 4.1.x in KRaft mode by default) and a Kafka client EC2 instance in a private subnet of the same VPC. You connect to the instance with Session Manager to interact with the MSK cluster.
- An AWS SAM project with a Lambda Function to demonstrate SASL authentication.

To test this pattern, first deploy the CloudFormation stack using the template file MSKSampleStack.yml under msk-cfn-sasl-lambda/create-cluster-cfn. The cluster type defaults to provisioned, which SASL/SCRAM needs. The provisioned cluster enables TLS, SASL/SCRAM and IAM authentication, and the serverless cluster enables IAM. Follow msk-cfn-sasl-lambda/create-cluster-cfn/README.md for detailed instructions
Next step is to deploy the Lambda Function. Follow steps under msk-cfn-sasl-lambda/README.md to deploy and test the Lambda Function.
Note - MSK Serverless doesn't support SASL/SCRAM authentication, so use the provisioned cluster for this pattern.
